# Scoped third-party notices

`scripts/rsi_mjlab_motion_backend.py` adapts motion-command scheduling from
[xiaojxkevin/G1-mjlab-soccer](https://github.com/xiaojxkevin/G1-mjlab-soccer),
revision `45e3d1e89ee924a263ff08d810fda5473dc3979d`, under its root `LICENCE`
(Apache License 2.0; text retained in `licenses/g1-mjlab-soccer-APACHE-2.0.txt`).
The upstream license includes the Isaac Lab Project Developers attribution.
ROSClaw modifications: explicit episode boundaries, fixed action offsets,
current-state reference-command observations, physical ball dimensions and
contact-root correction. This file is Apache-2.0 scoped, not implicitly MIT.

External simulator frameworks retain their own licenses. No reference weights,
motion datasets or meshes are redistributed here; their publication scope must
be checked separately before promotional or redistributed model artifacts.
